why: Exceptionally clean budget card with a hand-built hover-scrubbable SVG chart and no heavy dependencies.
Complete drag-drop upload card with progress, removal, callbacks, accessibility, and ordinary shadcn plus Motion code.
Four compact AI processing states are clean, meaningful, dependency-light, and directly useful for Oracle flows.
A polished end-to-end booking card with location selection, availability, accessible states, callbacks, and confirmation flow.
Composable tool-call card supports loading, success, error, raw data, and collapsible details with clean primitives.
Dark compact market chart has pointer scrubbing, period switching, and live header feedback; bundle shows no heavy graphics runtime.
Actually working task tracker supports adding, completing, and progress counting in simple shadcn stateful code.
A clean configurable floating launcher expands into arbitrary content with no dependency beyond React and Lucide.
Real second-by-second countdown, urgent state, reduced-motion support, and join callback make this more than decoration.
Focused quoted comment thread with replies, composer, resolve action, and clean product-app density; source is unavailable.
Strong live-agent processing card communicates staged work and progress in a compact dark operator-ready form; source is unavailable.
Fully stateful timed prediction flow includes vote bars, amount entry, quick values, callbacks, and animated confirmation.
Clean dense team-chat card includes status, reactions, read states, composer, and action affordances; source is unavailable.
Useful AI credit wallet pattern combines balance, usage, transactions, and a top-up callback in plain shadcn code.
Clean mixed activity feed with system events, comments, timestamps, and inline reply, though source is unavailable.
Well-organized product notification preferences with useful category grouping and toggles; source is unavailable.
Polished animated sleep-stage summary is reusable for model performance tracking but mostly presents supplied data.
Compact reusable stock row has typed data, formatting, movement states, hover motion, and a buy callback.
Dependency-free swipeable card deck has falling transitions, blur reveals, arrows, dots, and accessible state.
Compact dark AI chat includes a real composer and animated response flow, but is visually basic and less reusable than the best picks.
Very clean social-post layout with engagement controls and link preview, though source is unavailable and product fit is secondary.
Useful savings-goal progress layout is clear and reusable but mainly static presentation.
Dense CRM shell is highly product-relevant, but the component is a broad demo section rather than a clean portable primitive.
Clean availability profile card has consultation and bookmark actions, but it is conventional and narrowly themed.
Clear weekly expense summary with ring and category breakdown could adapt to operator spend, though source evidence is limited.
A tidy dark dashboard quartet covers core operator metrics and actions, but is mostly static and source is unavailable.
Useful project milestone and team-status layout, but supplied source references undefined Card03Props and does not compile.
